title: An outbound request carries at most one body, named by which of four flat keys it is written under, and a second key or a body on `get` is a compile-time diagnostic
divergesFromPhp: curl takes `CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS` as a string, an array or a file handle and infers the encoding from which one it got; here the key names what is sent, two keys are refused before the program runs, and a `Part::file` streams from disk rather than being held whole
